verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on Glama's pricing page saying users can "automate workflows using schedules or webhooks." That implies scheduled or event-triggered background automation, but nothing describes how it works, what it can run, or whether agents act autonomously. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the workflow/automation feature, details on schedule and webhook triggers, evidence of autonomous agent execution in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
